Devon Park: Follow-up on the recent billing overcount incident — combining action items from the retro. Main asks: who will own the canonicalization of token aggregation, backlog remediation, and invoice correction process?

Mina Ortiz: I can own the canonicalization effort. Plan: enforce single aggregation path in the pipeline and add checksums to the daily aggregates.

Devon Park: Thanks. Can you estimate ETA? We need something merged before next deploy window (2025-12-08).

Mina Ortiz: Targeting 2025-12-06 for PR + tests. Will break work into two PRs (schema + pipelining).

Jonah Keane: I'll take the invoice correction pipeline (generate credit memos, post to billing queue). Need list of affected invoices from the backfill.

BillingBot: ALERT: 31 invoices flagged for potential adjustment. Ticket: BILL-2305.

OpsAlice: Ops will add a deploy guard to disable aggressive retries for 3 minutes post-deploy. Also adding a synthetic metric to detect retry storms.

Samir Gupta: For backfill, prefer idempotent adjustments (write-only adjustment ledger). Also recommend a staged rollout: canary 10 invoices -> 100 -> all.

Devon Park: Owners & due dates:
- Mina Ortiz 99 canonicalization + checksums 99 due 2025-12-06
- Jonah Keane 99 invoice correction pipeline 99 due 2025-12-09
- OpsAlice 99 deploy guard + metrics 99 due 2025-12-03
- Samir Gupta 99 backfill job + staged rollout 99 due 2025-12-07
Please ACK here.

Mina Ortiz: ACK. Will add tests and a migration for checksum column.

Jonah Keane: ACK. Will coordinate with BillingOps for credit memo format.

BillingBot: NOTE: BillingOps assigned to review credits: @Claire, @Maria.

Devon Park: A couple of constraints:
- Backfill should never mutate raw usage rows — only write adjustments
- We need audit trail: job_run_id, PR links, operator who approved
- Provide a dry-run mode with a signed CSV that BillingOps can review

Samir Gupta: I'll include a dry-run flag and S3 path for signed CSV. Also adding leader election using k8s lease.

OpsAlice: Implemented canary throttle in staging. Will proceed to prod after engineering signoff.

Mina Ortiz: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/pull/789 (adds checksum and aggregation guard).

Jonah Keane: Dry-run CSV uploaded to /private/drive/BILL-2305/dryrun_2439990001.csv. BillingOps review pending.

Devon Park: Sync 2025-12-05 11:00 PT to sign off on canary. If all good, proceed with bulk adjustments and send customer comms.

BillingBot: BillingOps checklist updated for BILL-2305. 31 invoices in review.

Devon Park: Thanks team. Update ticket with PR links and completion times. Closing thread until sync. :white_check_mark:
